newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE commodity turnover hits record in June.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE commodity turnover hits record in June.

text.p: LIFFE said its commodity contract turnover reached 472,725 contracts in June, the highest since the merger with the London Commodity Exchange last September.
It a statement, LIFFE said its cocoa futures set a new monthly record of 228,615 contracts in June and a new daily record volume since the merger of 31,560 contracts on June 12.
Cocoa futures rallied to one year-highs in June before falling slightly this week.

The rally followed a surge in fund buying as well as manufacturer purchases on concerns over the 1997/98 crop development in West Africa and the longer-term impact of the El Nino weather pattern on the future harvest.
LIFFE said coffee futures volume reached 152,217 contracts gainst 147,214 in May. Options volume however fell to 15,719 from 19,000 a month earlier.
Volume of white sugar futures rose to 58,523 contracts from 42,517 but wheat fell to 7,385 from 12,110. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
